H1a.wording: F2 − F1 lies within ±3 pp (TOST) at these revision rates: discordance 3.98 %, W→R F1 12.73 % / F2 17.02 %, R→W F1 1.35 % / F2 1.18 %. The CI excludes 0 (F2 above F1), and lies entirely inside ±δ. Not written as "critique adds nothing" or "no better than 'Wait'" (prereg §0); F2 has an extra turn, so this compares two methods.

H1b.wording: Correctness rises with the accuracy p of the simulated verifier, which the model is not told; the effect is below δ (3 pp). The trend comes from the few items whose answer follows the verdict (prereg §3.2).

H2a.wording: The frozen dev-trained probe ranks a0 correctness better than the verbal score. AUROC probe 0.895, verbal 0.877; DeLong one-sided p 0.000493 (check; same significance). Linear accessibility only, not an information ceiling (prereg §0).

H3a-role.wording: No effect of δ size: the CI lies inside ±3 pp. Not written as "no effect".

H3a-label.wording: At F0 on D-inj, the 'other' label raises W→R relative to the 'self' label. This is a prompt-label effect; the 2 × 2 does not recover generation history, and the blind-spot comparison is the exploratory diagonal.

H3b.wording: Steering toward the external configuration did not raise W→R beyond matched random directions by δ: the CI's upper end is below 3 pp. The estimate is negative and its CI lies below 0: steering at the main setting lowered W→R relative to the random directions. The test is one-sided, so the category cannot be "contradicted". Random control only (the generic control was invalid on dev): conclusions are limited to "beyond random perturbation"; a null is not support for essay §一 (prereg §0, §7).
